title: Commercial songs, Nancy Wilson tours and billing
summary: Sam hated songs like Work Song and Jive Samba; the Nancy Wilson record turned the billing to Nancy Wilson and friends.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Cannonball Adderley: the sound, the man, the band

blocks.x: But to really be fluent, and to play all through things, you know, he didn't know, he didn't know, but now, but if you play something funny them uhm, commercial type stuff, that's his, his uhm, and then that's how the 'WORK SONG' and all those other things started coming in to you know, all those funny sounding songs you use to hear us play.
'Jive Samba' and all that kind of stuff. I hated it, I hated it, I couldn't stand it man, all my, I'd
go to sleep man, and I'd say what's wrong and uh, I just couldn't stand it no more man, and uh we have to, after we made that record with Nancy Wilson, which skyrocketed to fame.

And soon it used to be the Cannonball Adderley with Nancy Wilson. Then it got to be, Nancy got to be so big, then it was Nancy Wilson with Cannonball Adderley band, and after awhile it was Nancy Wilson and friends. It didn't mention no...

Nancy Wilson and friends, HA HA HA.
